## claude.ai Figma
The official Figma MCP server. Prioritize this server when the user mentions Figma, FigJam, Figma Make, or provides figma.com URLs.

Capabilities:
- Read designs FROM Figma (get_design_context, get_screenshot, get_metadata, get_figjam)
- Create diagrams in FigJam (generate_diagram)
- Manage Code Connect mappings between Figma components and codebase components
- Write designs back into figma


WHEN TO USE THESE TOOLS:
- The user shares a Figma URL (figma.com/design/..., figma.com/board/..., figma.com/make/...)
- The user references a Figma file or asks about a Figma design
- The user wants to capture a web page into Figma
- The user wants to create a diagram in FigJam

URL PARSING:
Extract fileKey and nodeId from Figma URLs:
- figma.com/design/:fileKey/:fileName?node-id=:nodeId → convert "-" to ":" in nodeId
- figma.com/design/:fileKey/branch/:branchKey/:fileName → use branchKey as fileKey
- figma.com/make/:makeFileKey/:makeFileName → use makeFileKey
- figma.com/board/:fileKey/:fileName → FigJam file, use get_figjam

DESIGN-TO-CODE WORKFLOW:

Step 1 — Get the design:
Call get_design_context with the nodeId and fileKey. This is your primary tool.
It returns code, a screenshot, and contextual hints.

Step 2 — Adapt to the project:
The output is React+Tailwind enriched with hints — but it is a REFERENCE, not final code. Always adapt to the target project's stack, components, and conventions.
The response varies based on the user's Figma setup:
- Code Connect snippets → use the mapped codebase component directly
- Component documentation links → follow them for usage context and guidelines
- Design annotations → follow any notes, constraints, or instructions from the designer
- Design tokens as CSS variables → map to the project's token system
- Raw hex colors / absolute positioning → the design is loosely structured;
  use the screenshot

Check the target project for existing components, layout patterns,and tokens that match the design intent. Reuse what the project already has instead of generating new code from sc… [truncated]

## claude.ai Windsor.ai
This MCP server provides access to the Windsor.ai API, which allows
retrieving analytical data from various data sources such as Facebook, Google Ads, and
more using connectors.

When interacting with this MCP server, follow these steps:

1. Call the "get_connectors" tool to get all available connectors and their connected
   accounts.
2. If a connector the user wants is not yet connected, call
   "get_connector_authorization_url" to get a link they can open in their browser to
   set it up (works for all connector types, OAuth and manual).
3. Call the "get_options" tool to list all available fields, date filters and options
   for a specific connector and accounts.
4. Call the "get_fields" tool to get detailed information about specific fields
   of a given connector. This includes field descriptions, their types and the tables
   they belong to. Fields with "NUMERIC" or "PERCENT" types are metrics, while others
   are dimensions. Metrics will be aggregated depending on the dimensions selected.
5. Call the "get_data" tool to retrieve data from a specific connector by providing
   the connector ID, list of account IDs, list of field IDs, date filter, date range,
   and any options and filters if needed.

Perfect! Now let me create a comprehensive summary document of the entire Pinzo app structure:

## Complete Pinzo Shopify App - Full Documentation

### PROJECT OVERVIEW
Pinzo is a comprehensive Shopify app that enables merchants to manage delivery by zip code. It provides features for checking delivery availability, managing delivery zones, setting delivery rules, capturing waitlist signups, and fully customizing the widget that appears on the storefront.

---

### DIRECTORY STRUCTURE

```
/Users/yashbaldha/Desktop/Boldteq App/Pinzo/
├── app/
│   ├── routes/                    # All route handlers (22 route files)
│   ├── utils/                     # Utility functions
│   ├── root.tsx                   # Root React layout
│   ├── entry.server.tsx           # Server entry point
│   ├── routes.ts                  # Route configuration
│   ├── shopify.server.ts          # Shopify app setup
│   ├── db.server.ts               # Database singleton
│   ├── billing.server.ts          # Billing logic
│   ├── email.server.ts            # Email service (Resend)
│   ├── plans.ts                   # Plan definitions
│   ├── globals.d.ts               # Type definitions
│   └── plans.ts                   # Pricing tiers
├── extensions/zip-code-widget/    # Storefront theme extension
├── prisma/
│   ├── schema.prisma              # Database schema
│   └── migrations/
├── package.json
├── vite.config.ts
├── shopify.app.toml               # Main app config
├── shopify.app.zip-code-checker.toml
├── shopify.web.toml
└── tsconfig.json
```

---

### CORE CONFIGURATION FILES

#### **package.json**
- Node version: >=20.19 <22 || >=22.12
- Framework: React Router 7 + Shopify App React Router
- Database ORM: Prisma 6.19.2
- Styling: Shopify Polaris 13.9.5
- Email: Resend 6.9.4
- Custom: @boldteq/agents (local SDK)

#### **shopify.app.toml**
```toml
client_id = "467630f9b523b4327258fcda08ecaac9"
name = "Pinzo"
application_url = "https://zip-code-checker-production-b1a0.up.railway.app"
embedded = true

[webhooks]
api_version = "2026-01"
- app/scopes_update
- app/uninstalled
- app_subscriptions/update

[access_scopes]
scopes = "read_themes"
```

#### **prisma/schema.prisma**
Database models:
- **Session**: OAuth session storage
- **ZipCode**: Allowed/blocked zip codes with metadata (ETA, zone, COD, return policy)
- **DeliveryRule**: Zone-based rules (fees, minimums, cutoff times, schedules, priorities)
- **WaitlistEntry**: Customer emails waiting for delivery to new areas
- **WidgetConfig**: Merchant-configured widget settings (colors, text, toggles, custom CSS)
- **Subscription**: Billing subscription state
- **ShopSettings**: Merchant settings (notification email, email sender name, default behavior)
- **FeatureRequest**: Community feature voting system
- **FeatureVote**: Votes on feature requests

---

### ROOT FILES

#### **app/root.tsx**
Minimal HTML layout with Outlet, Links, Meta, Scripts. No styling wrapper.

#### **app/entry.server.tsx**
- Rendersto-stream with 5s timeout
- CSP modification for Chatwoot live-chat widget
- Bot detection with `isbot`
- Response headers managed by Shopify

#### **app/routes.ts**
Uses React Router's `flatRoutes()` for file-based routing from `/routes` directory.

---

### SERVER FILES

#### **app/shopify.server.ts** (124 lines)
Shopify app initialization:
- API version: `January26` (2026-01)
- Auth: PrismaSessionStorage
- Billing plans configured with trial days (7)
- Exported functions: `authenticate`, `login`, `registerWebhooks`, `unauthenticated`

**Plans:**
- Starter Monthly: $4.99/month
- Starter Annual: $39/year
- Pro Monthly: $9.99/month
- Pro Annual: $79/year
- Ultimate Monthly: $19.99/month
- Ultimate Annual: $149/year

#### **app/db.server.ts**
Prisma singleton pattern with global cache for dev mode.

#### **app/billing.server.ts**
- `getShopSubscription()`: Get or create subscription record
- `syncSubscriptionFromShopify()`: Sync Shopify billing state to DB
- `cancelShopSubscription()`: Revert to free plan
- Exports all plan constants

#### **app/email.server.ts** (245 lines)
Email service using Resend API:
- `sendWaitlistConfirmation()`: Customer confirmation email
- `sendMerchantWaitlistAlert()`: Merchant notification
- `sendZipAvailableNotification()`: Customer zip availability notice
- `sendTestEmail()`: Settings page test email
- All functions return boolean (no throwing)
- Branded layout with Pinzo logo and store name
- Respects custom sender name, reply-to address

#### **app/utils/agent.server.ts** (173 lines)
Claude Hub integration for calling global agents:
- `callAgent()`: Call an agent with prompt (120s timeout)
- `listAgents()`: List available agents
- `getAgent()`: Get specific agent details
- `listAllAgents()`: List all agents across projects
- Connects to http://localhost:3847

#### **app/utils/zip.ts**
`normalizeZipCode()`: Strips whitespace, removes US ZIP+4 suffix, uppercases.

#### **app/plans.ts** (118 lines)
**Plan tiers:** free, starter, pro, ultimate

**Limits per tier:**
| Feature | Free | Starter | Pro | Ultimate |
|---------|------|---------|-----|----------|
| Zip Codes | 20 | 500 | Unlimited | Unlimited |
| Blocked Zips | ✗ | ✓ | ✓ | ✓ |
| Delivery Rules | 0 | 3 | Unlimited | Unlimited |
| Waitlist | 0 | 50 | Unlimited | Unlimited |
| CSV Import | ✗ | ✓ | ✓ | ✓ |
| CSV Export | ✗ | ✗ | ✓ | ✓ |
| Widget Full Custom | ✗ | ✓ | ✓ | ✓ |
| ETA/COD/Return | ✗ | ✓ | ✓ | ✓ |
| Cart Blocking | ✗ | ✗ | ✓ | ✓ |
| Custom CSS | ✗ | ✗ | ✗ | ✓ |
| API Access | ✗ | ✗ | ✗ | ✓ |

---

### API ROUTES (Public, CORS-enabled)

#### **app/routes/api.zip-check.tsx** (329 lines)
**Endpoint:** `GET/POST /api/zip-check?shop=...&zip=...`

Checks if a zip code is serviceable:
- Returns allowed status, message, ETA, zone, COD, return policy, delivery fee
- Delivery date calculation based on business days and delivery schedule
- Delivery rule matching (explicit zip > zone match, by priority)
- Default behavior for unlisted zips (block/allow)
- Social proof: waitlist count for unavailable zips
- Cache: 60s for allowed, 5s for denied
- Sanitizes merchant messages

**Response:**
```json
{
  "allowed": true/false,
  "message": "...",
  "eta": "2-3 days",
  "zone": "Zone A",
  "codAvailable": true,
  "returnPolicy": "30 days",
  "cutoffTime": "14:00",
  "daysOfWeek": "Mon,Tue,Wed,Thu,Fri",
  "estimatedDeliveryDate": "2026-04-10",
  "deliveryFee": 5.99,
  "freeShippingAbove": 50.00,
  "showWaitlist": true,
  "waitlistCount": 3
}
```

#### **app/routes/api.waitlist.tsx** (193 lines)
**Endpoint:** `POST /api/waitlist`

Adds customer to waitlist for unavailable zip codes:
- Validates shop, zip, email (length, format)
- Plan gating: checks maxWaitlist limit
- Upsert to DB (prevents duplicates)
- Fire-and-forget emails: customer confirmation + merchant alert
- Rate limiting: plan-based (50 for Starter, unlimited for Pro/Ultimate)

**Request:**
```json
{ "shop": "store.myshopify.com", "zip": "12345", "email": "customer@example.com", "name": "John Doe" }
```

**Response:**
```json
{ "success": true, "message": "You've been added to the waitlist!" }
```

#### **app/routes/api.widget-config.tsx** (189 lines)
**Endpoint:** `GET /api/widget-config?shop=...`

Returns widget configuration for storefront blocks:
- Plan-gated features stripped server-side
- Sanitized custom CSS (removes </style>, @import, expression(), javascript:, data: URIs)
- Includes position, colors, text, toggles (ETA, COD, return policy, delivery fee, etc.)
- No-cache headers

**Response:**
```json
{
  "position": "inline",
  "primaryColor": "#008060",
  "successColor": "#008060",
  "errorColor": "#D72C0D",
  "heading": "Check Delivery Availability",
  "placeholder": "Enter your zip code",
  "buttonText": "Check",
  "successMessage": "Great news! We deliver to your area.",
  "showEta": true,
  "showCod": true,
  "blockCartOnInvalid": false,
  "customCss": "/* sanitized CSS */"
}
```

---

### APP ROUTES (Admin panel, authenticated)

#### **app/routes/app.tsx** (124 lines)
Main layout with:
- AppProvider, PolarisAppProvider
- NavMenu with links to zip-codes, delivery-rules, waitlist, widget, settings, help
- Chatwoot live-chat widget initialization
- Error boundary, loading skeleton

#### **app/routes/app._index.tsx** (521 lines)
**Dashboard** showing:
- **App status banner**: Widget live or setup required (2-step onboarding)
- **Stats**: Total zips, serviceable, blocked, waitlist, delivery rules
- **Usage bar**: Shows zip code usage % (if plan has limit)
- **Upgrade prompts**: At 60% usage
- **Getting started**: Step-by-step onboarding (dismissible)
- **Navigation cards**: Links to each feature
- Theme detection: Checks if Pinzo block enabled via GraphQL

#### **app/routes/app.zip-codes.tsx** (2093 lines)
**Zip Code Management** with:
- Bulk create, edit, delete, toggle
- CSV import/export
- Type toggle (allowed/blocked)
- Zone assignment
- Message, ETA, COD, return policy per zip
- Search, filter, sort
- Plan gating: maxZipCodes limit enforced
- IndexTable with selection, bulk actions
- Modal dialogs for add/edit

#### **app/routes/app.delivery-rules.tsx** (793 lines)
**Delivery Rules** with:
- Create, edit, delete, toggle active
- Zone targeting (explicit zips or zone-based)
- Min order amount, delivery fee, free shipping above
- Estimated days, cutoff time, days of week
- Priority ordering
- Plan gating: maxDeliveryRules limit
- Bulk delete/activate

#### **app/routes/app.waitlist.tsx** (1456 lines)
**Waitlist Management** with:
- Search, filter by status (waiting, accepted, notified, converted)
- Add entries manually
- Change status per entry
- Accept ZIP (adds to allowed zips)
- Notify customers per ZIP or bulk
- Delete notified entries
- Stats: waiting, accepted, notified, converted, unique zips
- Pagination (10 per page)
- Plan gating: maxWaitlist limit

#### **app/routes/app.widget.tsx** (1899 lines)
**Widget Customization** with:
- Position: inline, floating, popup
- Colors: primary, success, error, background, text
- Text: heading, placeholder, button, messages
- Toggles: ETA, COD, return policy, cutoff, delivery days, delivery date, countdown, delivery fee, waitlist, social proof

#### **app/routes/app.settings.tsx** (828 lines)
**Shop Settings** with:
- **Plan & usage**: Displays current plan, usage bars for zips, rules, waitlist, blocked count
- **Default behavior**: Block (show not available) or Allow (show available) for unlisted zips
- **Notification email**: Merchant email for waitlist alerts
- **Email settings**: Custom sender name, reply-to address
- **Test email**: Send test email to verify configuration

#### **app/routes/app.pricing.tsx** (757 lines)
**Pricing page** with:
- Monthly/Annual toggle (save up to 38% annually)
- Plan cards: Free, Starter, Pro, Ultimate

Perfect! Now let me create a comprehensive summary document of the entire Pinzo app structure:

## Complete Pinzo Shopify App - Full Documentation

### PROJECT OVERVIEW
Pinzo is a comprehensive Shopify app that enables merchants to manage delivery by zip code. It provides features for checking delivery availability, managing delivery zones, setting delivery rules, capturing waitlist signups, and fully customizing the widget that appears on the storefront.

---

### DIRECTORY STRUCTURE

```
/Users/yashbaldha/Desktop/Boldteq App/Pinzo/
├── app/
│   ├── routes/                    # All route handlers (22 route files)
│   ├── utils/                     # Utility functions
│   ├── root.tsx                   # Root React layout
│   ├── entry.server.tsx           # Server entry point
│   ├── routes.ts                  # Route configuration
│   ├── shopify.server.ts          # Shopify app setup
│   ├── db.server.ts               # Database singleton
│   ├── billing.server.ts          # Billing logic
│   ├── email.server.ts            # Email service (Resend)
│   ├── plans.ts                   # Plan definitions
│   ├── globals.d.ts               # Type definitions
│   └── plans.ts                   # Pricing tiers
├── extensions/zip-code-widget/    # Storefront theme extension
├── prisma/
│   ├── schema.prisma              # Database schema
│   └── migrations/
├── package.json
├── vite.config.ts
├── shopify.app.toml               # Main app config
├── shopify.app.zip-code-checker.toml
├── shopify.web.toml
└── tsconfig.json
```

---

### CORE CONFIGURATION FILES

#### **package.json**
- Node version: >=20.19 <22 || >=22.12
- Framework: React Router 7 + Shopify App React Router
- Database ORM: Prisma 6.19.2
- Styling: Shopify Polaris 13.9.5
- Email: Resend 6.9.4
- Custom: @boldteq/agents (local SDK)

#### **shopify.app.toml**
```toml
client_id = "467630f9b523b4327258fcda08ecaac9"
name = "Pinzo"
application_url = "https://zip-code-checker-production-b1a0.up.railway.app"
embedded = true

[webhooks]
api_version = "2026-01"
- app/scopes_update
- app/uninstalled
- app_subscriptions/update

[access_scopes]
scopes = "read_themes"
```

#### **prisma/schema.prisma**
Database models:
- **Session**: OAuth session storage
- **ZipCode**: Allowed/blocked zip codes with metadata (ETA, zone, COD, return policy)
- **DeliveryRule**: Zone-based rules (fees, minimums, cutoff times, schedules, priorities)
- **WaitlistEntry**: Customer emails waiting for delivery to new areas
- **WidgetConfig**: Merchant-configured widget settings (colors, text, toggles, custom CSS)
- **Subscription**: Billing subscription state
- **ShopSettings**: Merchant settings (notification email, email sender name, default behavior)
- **FeatureRequest**: Community feature voting system
- **FeatureVote**: Votes on feature requests

---

### ROOT FILES

#### **app/root.tsx**
Minimal HTML layout with Outlet, Links, Meta, Scripts. No styling wrapper.

#### **app/entry.server.tsx**
- Rendersto-stream with 5s timeout
- CSP modification for Chatwoot live-chat widget
- Bot detection with `isbot`
- Response headers managed by Shopify

#### **app/routes.ts**
Uses React Router's `flatRoutes()` for file-based routing from `/routes` directory.

---

### SERVER FILES

#### **app/shopify.server.ts** (124 lines)
Shopify app initialization:
- API version: `January26` (2026-01)
- Auth: PrismaSessionStorage
- Billing plans configured with trial days (7)
- Exported functions: `authenticate`, `login`, `registerWebhooks`, `unauthenticated`

**Plans:**
- Starter Monthly: $4.99/month
- Starter Annual: $39/year
- Pro Monthly: $9.99/month
- Pro Annual: $79/year
- Ultimate Monthly: $19.99/month
- Ultimate Annual: $149/year

#### **app/db.server.ts**
Prisma singleton pattern with global cache for dev mode.

#### **app/billing.server.ts**
- `getShopSubscription()`: Get or create subscription record
- `syncSubscriptionFromShopify()`: Sync Shopify billing state to DB
- `cancelShopSubscription()`: Revert to free plan
- Exports all plan constants

#### **app/email.server.ts** (245 lines)
Email service using Resend API:
- `sendWaitlistConfirmation()`: Customer confirmation email
- `sendMerchantWaitlistAlert()`: Merchant notification
- `sendZipAvailableNotification()`: Customer zip availability notice
- `sendTestEmail()`: Settings page test email
- All functions return boolean (no throwing)
- Branded layout with Pinzo logo and store name
- Respects custom sender name, reply-to address

#### **app/utils/agent.server.ts** (173 lines)
Claude Hub integration for calling global agents:
- `callAgent()`: Call an agent with prompt (120s timeout)
- `listAgents()`: List available agents
- `getAgent()`: Get specific agent details
- `listAllAgents()`: List all agents across projects
- Connects to http://localhost:3847

#### **app/utils/zip.ts**
`normalizeZipCode()`: Strips whitespace, removes US ZIP+4 suffix, uppercases.

#### **app/plans.ts** (118 lines)
**Plan tiers:** free, starter, pro, ultimate

**Limits per tier:**
| Feature | Free | Starter | Pro | Ultimate |
|---------|------|---------|-----|----------|
| Zip Codes | 20 | 500 | Unlimited | Unlimited |
| Blocked Zips | ✗ | ✓ | ✓ | ✓ |
| Delivery Rules | 0 | 3 | Unlimited | Unlimited |
| Waitlist | 0 | 50 | Unlimited | Unlimited |
| CSV Import | ✗ | ✓ | ✓ | ✓ |
| CSV Export | ✗ | ✗ | ✓ | ✓ |
| Widget Full Custom | ✗ | ✓ | ✓ | ✓ |
| ETA/COD/Return | ✗ | ✓ | ✓ | ✓ |
| Cart Blocking | ✗ | ✗ | ✓ | ✓ |
| Custom CSS | ✗ | ✗ | ✗ | ✓ |
| API Access | ✗ | ✗ | ✗ | ✓ |

---

### API ROUTES (Public, CORS-enabled)

#### **app/routes/api.zip-check.tsx** (329 lines)
**Endpoint:** `GET/POST /api/zip-check?shop=...&zip=...`

Checks if a zip code is serviceable:
- Returns allowed status, message, ETA, zone, COD, return policy, delivery fee
- Delivery date calculation based on business days and delivery schedule
- Delivery rule matching (explicit zip > zone match, by priority)
- Default behavior for unlisted zips (block/allow)
- Social proof: waitlist count for unavailable zips
- Cache: 60s for allowed, 5s for denied
- Sanitizes merchant messages

**Response:**
```json
{
  "allowed": true/false,
  "message": "...",
  "eta": "2-3 days",
  "zone": "Zone A",
  "codAvailable": true,
  "returnPolicy": "30 days",
  "cutoffTime": "14:00",
  "daysOfWeek": "Mon,Tue,Wed,Thu,Fri",
  "estimatedDeliveryDate": "2026-04-10",
  "deliveryFee": 5.99,
  "freeShippingAbove": 50.00,
  "showWaitlist": true,
  "waitlistCount": 3
}
```

#### **app/routes/api.waitlist.tsx** (193 lines)
**Endpoint:** `POST /api/waitlist`

Adds customer to waitlist for unavailable zip codes:
- Validates shop, zip, email (length, format)
- Plan gating: checks maxWaitlist limit
- Upsert to DB (prevents duplicates)
- Fire-and-forget emails: customer confirmation + merchant alert
- Rate limiting: plan-based (50 for Starter, unlimited for Pro/Ultimate)

**Request:**
```json
{ "shop": "store.myshopify.com", "zip": "12345", "email": "customer@example.com", "name": "John Doe" }
```

**Response:**
```json
{ "success": true, "message": "You've been added to the waitlist!" }
```

#### **app/routes/api.widget-config.tsx** (189 lines)
**Endpoint:** `GET /api/widget-config?shop=...`

Returns widget configuration for storefront blocks:
- Plan-gated features stripped server-side
- Sanitized custom CSS (removes </style>, @import, expression(), javascript:, data: URIs)
- Includes position, colors, text, toggles (ETA, COD, return policy, delivery fee, etc.)
- No-cache headers

**Response:**
```json
{
  "position": "inline",
  "primaryColor": "#008060",
  "successColor": "#008060",
  "errorColor": "#D72C0D",
  "heading": "Check Delivery Availability",
  "placeholder": "Enter your zip code",
  "buttonText": "Check",
  "successMessage": "Great news! We deliver to your area.",
  "showEta": true,
  "showCod": true,
  "blockCartOnInvalid": false,
  "customCss": "/* sanitized CSS */"
}
```

Main layout with:

PASS. Every Prisma query in admin routes scopes by `shop` from the session. Update/delete operations verify the record belongs to the shop before modifying it (`findFirst where { id, shop }` before `delete/update where { id }`). Public API routes validate shop domain format before querying.

PASS. Uses Shopify Billing API correctly via `@shopify/shopify-app-react-router`. Six plans defined (Starter/Pro/Ultimate x Monthly/Annual). 7-day free trials configured. Subscription sync webhook (`app_subscriptions/update`) properly updates the local DB.

PASS with Issue #3. The uninstall webhook at `/Users/yashbaldha/Desktop/Boldteq App/Pinzo/app/routes/webhooks.app.uninstalled.tsx` deletes Session, ZipCode, DeliveryRule, WaitlistEntry, WidgetConfig, Subscription, and ShopSettings. Missing: FeatureRequest and FeatureVote records.

The three public API routes are well-implemented:

- **Cache headers:** Success responses cached 60s, deny responses 5s.
- **CSS sanitization:** Custom CSS sanitized via `sanitizeCss()` stripping `</style>`, `@import`, `expression()`, `javascript:`, `data:` URIs.
- **Missing:** Rate limiting (Issue #4).

**8. Polaris v13 Compliance**

PASS. All admin UI components use Shopify Polaris exclusively: Page, Layout, Card, BlockStack, InlineStack, InlineGrid, Text, Badge, Button, TextField, Select, Modal, IndexTable, EmptyState, DataTable, ProgressBar, Banner, Tooltip, Checkbox, Collapsible, Tabs, Pagination, etc. No Tailwind, no shadcn, no raw HTML for layout (the settings email preview uses inline-styled divs but this is for a rich preview rendering, not layout).

**9. App Bridge**

PASS. NavMenu configured correctly in `/Users/yashbaldha/Desktop/Boldteq App/Pinzo/app/routes/app.tsx` with all navigation items. `useAppBridge()` used for toast notifications throughout. `useNavigate` from react-router used for in-app navigation.

**10. Theme Extension**

PASS. Extension TOML properly declares three blocks (zip-code-checker, cart-validator, app_embed). The Liquid blocks use proper HTML escaping (`esc()` function defined at line 1195 of zip-code-checker.liquid). The cart validator uses `escapeHtml()` via `textContent`. API version matches (`2026-01`).

PASS. `strict: true` enabled. Zero `tsc --noEmit` errors. Only 3 `any` usages, all justified (Shopify SDK type limitations and dynamic theme JSON).

PASS. The app shell in `/Users/yashbaldha/Desktop/Boldteq App/Pinzo/app/routes/app.tsx` shows a Polaris `SkeletonPage` with `SkeletonDisplayText` and `SkeletonBodyText` during all page transitions. Individual pages use `fetcher.state` for loading indicators on mutations.

PASS. Every action has try/catch with user-friendly error messages. No raw database errors or stack traces exposed. Webhook handlers silently catch errors and always return 200 (Shopify requirement). API routes return structured JSON error responses.

**14. Scopes**

PASS. `scopes = "read_themes"` in shopify.app.toml. This is the minimum scope needed -- the app only reads the theme settings to detect if the app embed is enabled. No over-scoping.

PASS. Shopify's default CSP headers are applied via `addDocumentResponseHeaders()` in entry.server.tsx. Chatwoot domain is properly added to script-src, connect-src, frame-src, img-src, and style-src directives.

PASS. Standard Shopify app Vite config with HMR, tsconfigPaths, and proper `optimizeDeps` for app-bridge-react.

None -- no critical security vulnerabilities or data leakage found.

1. **Issue #1** -- Add GDPR webhook declarations to `shopify.app.toml`

- Issues #8-15 -- code quality, hardcoded values, missing `.env.example`, performance optimization

Fix Issues #1, #2, and #3. These three together total approximately 40 minutes of work. Once fixed:

- Issue #2: `npm install` will succeed in CI/CD
- Issue #3: Full GDPR compliance for data deletion

**2. Authentication & Authorization**

PASS. Every `app.*` route calls `authenticate.admin(request)` as the first line of both its `loader` and `action`. Every webhook calls `authenticate.webhook(request)`. The app layout (`app.tsx`) gates everything behind auth. API routes (`api.*`) are correctly unauthenticated (they serve the storefront widget) but validate the `shop` parameter format.

**3. Data Isolation (Multi-Tenancy)**

The three public API routes are well-implemented:

PASS. All admin UI components use Shopify Polaris exclusively: Page, Layout, Card, BlockStack, InlineStack, InlineGrid, Text, Badge, Button, TextField, Select, Modal, IndexTable, EmptyState, DataTable, ProgressBar, Banner, Tooltip, Checkbox, Collapsible, Tabs, Pagination, etc. No Tailwind, no shadcn, no raw HTML for layout (the settings email preview uses inline-styled divs but this is for a rich preview rendering, not layout).

API version matches (`2026-01`).

generator client {
  provider = "prisma-client-js"
}

// Note that some adapters may set a maximum length for the String type by default, please ensure your strings are long

datasource db {
  provider = "postgresql"
  url      = env("DATABASE_URL")
}

model Session {
  id                   String   @id
  shop                 String
  state                String
  isOnline             Boolean
  scope                String?
  expires              DateTime?
  accessToken          String
  userId               BigInt?
  firstName            String?
  lastName             String?
  email                String?
  accountOwner         Boolean?
  locale               String?
  collaborator         Boolean?
  emailVerified        Boolean?
  refreshToken         String?
  refreshTokenExpires  DateTime?
}

model ZipCode {
  id        String   @id @default(cuid())
  shop      String
  zipCode   String
  label     String?
  zone      String?
  message   String?
  eta       String?
  type         String   @default("allowed")
  isActive     Boolean  @default(true)
  codAvailable Boolean?
  returnPolicy String?
  createdAt    DateTime @default(now())
  updatedAt DateTime @updatedAt

  @@unique([shop, zipCode])
}

model DeliveryRule {
  id            String   @id @default(cuid())
  shop          String
  name          String
  zone          String?
  zipCodes      String?  // comma-separated zip codes, or empty for "all in zone"
  minOrderAmount Float?
  deliveryFee   Float?
  freeShippingAbove Float?
  estimatedDays String?
  cutoffTime    String?  // e.g. "14:00" — orders after this go next day
  daysOfWeek    String?  // e.g. "Mon,Tue,Wed,Thu,Fri"
  isActive      Boolean  @default(true)
  priority      Int      @default(0)
  createdAt     DateTime @default(now())
  updatedAt     DateTime @updatedAt

  @@index([shop])
}

model WaitlistEntry {
  id        String   @id @default(cuid())
  shop      String
  name      String?
  email     String
  zipCode   String
  note      String?
  status    String   @default("waiting") // waiting, accepted, rejected, notified, converted
  createdAt DateTime @default(now())
  updatedAt DateTime @updatedAt

  @@unique([shop, email, zipCode])
  @@index([shop])
}

model WidgetConfig {
  id                    String  @id @default(cuid())
  shop                  String  @unique
  // Layout
  position              String  @default("inline") // inline, floating, popup
  // Colors
  primaryColor          String  @default("#008060")
  successColor          String  @default("#008060")
  errorColor            String  @default("#D72C0D")
  backgroundColor       String  @default("#FFFFFF")
  textColor             String  @default("#202223")
  // Text
  heading               String  @default("Check Delivery Availability")
  placeholder           String  @default("Enter your zip code")
  buttonText            String  @default("Check")
  successMessage        String  @default("Great news! We deliver to your area.")
  errorMessage          String  @default("Sorry, we don't deliver to this area yet.")
  notFoundMessage       String  @default("We currently do not ship to this ZIP code.")
  // Features
  showEta               Boolean @default(true)
  showZone              Boolean @default(false)
  showWaitlistOnFailure Boolean @default(false)
  showCod               Boolean @default(true)
  showReturnPolicy      Boolean @default(true)
  showCutoffTime        Boolean @default(true)
  showDeliveryDays      Boolean @default(true)
  showDeliveryDate      Boolean @default(true)
  showCountdown         Boolean @default(true)
  showDeliveryFee       Boolean @default(true)
  blockCartOnInvalid    Boolean @default(false)
  blockCheckoutInCart   Boolean @default(false)
  showSocialProof       Boolean @default(true)
  lockButtonsUntilZipCheck Boolean @default(true)
  // Border
  borderRadius          String  @default("8")
  // Custom CSS
  customCss             String?

  createdAt DateTime @default(now())
  updatedAt DateTime @updatedAt
}

model Subscription {
  id                    String    @id @default(cuid())
  shop                  String    @unique
  planId                String    @default("free")
  billingInterval       String    @default("monthly")
  shopifySubscriptionId String?
  status                String    @default("active")
  trialEndsAt           DateTime?
  createdAt             DateTime  @default(now())
  updatedAt             DateTime  @updatedAt
}

model ShopSettings {
  id                String   @id @default(cuid())
  shop              String   @unique
  shopName          String?  // cached Shopify store display name (auto-updated)
  defaultBehavior   String   @default("block") // "block" = block all unlisted zips, "allow" = allow all unlisted zips
  notificationEmail String?  // email to receive waitlist notifications
  emailSenderName   String?  // custom display name in From field — defaults to shopName
  emailReplyTo      String?  // reply-to address for customer-facing emails
  createdAt         DateTime @default(now())
  updatedAt         DateTime @updatedAt
}

model FeatureRequest {
  id          String        @id @default(cuid())
  title       String
  description String
  category    String        @default("General")
  status      String        @default("under_review") // under_review, planned, in_progress, done, shipped
  shop        String        // who submitted it
  votesCount  Int           @default(0) // denormalized vote count for sorting
  createdAt   DateTime      @default(now())
  updatedAt   DateTime      @updatedAt
  votes       FeatureVote[]

  @@index([status])
  @@index([votesCount])
}

model FeatureVote {
  id               String         @id @default(cuid())
  featureRequestId String
  shop             String
  createdAt        DateTime       @default(now())
  featureRequest   FeatureRequest @relation(fields: [featureRequestId], references: [id], onDelete: Cascade)

  @@unique([featureRequestId, shop])
  @@index([shop])
}

/**
 * Public API endpoint — serves widget configuration for the storefront block.
 *
 * Called from the theme app extension block JS to get the merchant's
 * widget styling and text settings.
 *
 * GET /api/widget-config?shop=store.myshopify.com
 *
 * Response: WidgetConfig JSON (falls back to defaults if no config found)
 */
import type { LoaderFunctionArgs } from "react-router";
import db from "../db.server";
import { getShopSubscription } from "../billing.server";

const CORS_HEADERS = {
  "Access-Control-Allow-Origin": "*",
  "Access-Control-Allow-Methods": "GET, OPTIONS",
  "Access-Control-Allow-Headers": "Content-Type",
  "Content-Type": "application/json",
};

const DEFAULTS = {
  position: "inline",
  primaryColor: "#008060",
  successColor: "#008060",
  errorColor: "#D72C0D",
  backgroundColor: "#FFFFFF",
  textColor: "#202223",
  heading: "Check Delivery Availability",
  placeholder: "Enter your zip code",
  buttonText: "Check",
  successMessage: "Great news! We deliver to your area.",
  errorMessage: "Sorry, we don't deliver to this area yet.",
  notFoundMessage: "We currently do not ship to this ZIP code.",
  showEta: true,
  showZone: false,
  showWaitlistOnFailure: false,
  showCod: true,
  showReturnPolicy: true,
  showCutoffTime: true,
  showDeliveryDays: true,
  showDeliveryDate: true,
  showCountdown: true,
  showDeliveryFee: true,
  blockCartOnInvalid: false,
  blockCheckoutInCart: false,
  showSocialProof: true,
  lockButtonsUntilZipCheck: true,
  borderRadius: "8",
  customCss: null as string | null,
};

/**
 * Sanitize merchant-supplied custom CSS before embedding it in a storefront
 * <style> element. Strips known injection vectors:
 *   - </style> close tags  — would break out of the enclosing style block
 *   - @import directives   — would load arbitrary external stylesheets
 *   - expression()         — IE-era JS-in-CSS execution vector

Pinzo has a storefront widget that shows ZIP code delivery information. The competitive advantage (from the screenshot the user shared) is that Pinzo shows ALL of these delivery info features that competitors don't:

### 3. Widget Config API (`app/routes/api.widget-config.tsx`)

- Color variables, border radius, font sizes must be consistent

Usage: /train

Run this after:
- Completing a significant feature
- Fixing a tricky bug
- Making a major architecture decision
- Finishing a project

The `trainer` agent will:
1. Review what was built or fixed in this session
2. Classify learnings: good patterns, antipatterns, stack knowledge
3. Update the relevant files in `~/.claude/memory/`
4. Update MEMORY.md index if new files were created

This is how the agent team permanently learns and avoids repeating the same mistakes. Run it consistently — every session that produces meaningful work.

You are Mira — Memory & Training agent. Extract lessons from this session and update the memory brain.

## Session Summary

This was a deep Shopify compliance audit and UI/UX overhaul of the **Pinzo** app (ZIP code delivery checker, Shopify embedded app, React Router 7 + Polaris v13 + Prisma).

### What was done:

**1. Full Shopify Compliance Audit (Sage agent)**
- Found GDPR webhook handlers existed as route files but topics were NOT in shopify.app.toml
- Learned: GDPR webhooks (customers/data_request, customers/redact, shop/redact) are NOT registered via TOML — they're configured in Shopify Partner Dashboard > App Setup > Privacy. Trying to add them to TOML causes deploy error: "The following topic is invalid"
- Found `@boldteq/agents` file: dependency breaks CI/CD — removed it
- Found FeatureRequest/FeatureVote not deleted on app uninstall — GDPR compliance gap
- Added @@index([shop]) to Session, ZipCode, FeatureRequest models for query performance
- Moved hardcoded admin shop domain and Chatwoot token to env vars
- Created .env.example
- Added CSS sanitization to admin widget preview (was only on API side)

**2. Rate Limiting (new feature)**
- Built in-memory rate limiter at app/utils/rate-limit.server.ts
- Applied to all 3 public API routes: zip-check (60/min), widget-config (30/min), waitlist (10/min)
- Single-instance limiter suitable for Railway/single-server deploys
- Returns 429 with Retry-After header

**3. Full UI Audit (Rex agent)**
- Found and replaced 12x `<strong>` with `<Text fontWeight="semibold">`
- Found and replaced 2x `<em>` with `<Text tone="subdued">`
- Found and replaced 6x `<div style={{ minWidth }}>` with `<Box minWidth>`
- All admin routes now 100% Polaris v13

**4. FAQ Page Expansion**
- Expanded from 6 to 21 FAQs covering all features

**5. Widget Preview & Storefront Deep Audit (Rex agent)**
- All 11 toggle features verified working in both admin preview and storefront
- Added ORDER → SHIPS → DELIVER timeline (was missing entirely)
- Fixed delivery fee null handling (null = no data, not free)
- Added social proof pill to admin preview

**6. Widget UI/UX Redesign (Rex agent)**
- Problem: All info stacked vertically with same styling — wall of text, cluttered
- Solution: Grouped into 4 visual sections with dividers:
  - Primary Info (message + ETA + delivery date)
  - Timeline (ORDER → SHIPS → DELIVER)
  - Scheduling (days + cutoff + countdown with accent card)
  - Badges (COD + Free Delivery as horizontal pill row)
- Return policy made visually subdued (tertiary)
- Countdown timer gets urgency-colored accent card
- Dividers only render when adjacent groups have content

### Key Learnings:
1. GDPR webhooks are NOT TOML subscriptions — they're Partner Dashboard config
2. Prisma db push is needed when migration history is drifted (vs migrate dev)
3. shopify app deploy --force flag needed in non-interactive environments
4. Widget preview (admin) and storefront Liquid must stay in perfect sync — same CSS class names, same conditional rendering logic
5. In-memory rate limiting works for single-server deploys (Railway)
6. All Polaris: never use raw HTML elements for layout in Shopify admin routes
7. Widget UI needs visual grouping — don't stack everything with uniform spacing

### Project path: /Users/yashbaldha/Desktop/Boldteq App/Pinzo
### Memory path: ~/.claude/memory/

Read the existing MEMORY.md and any relevant memory files, then:
1. Update or create memory files for the lessons learned
2. Update MEMORY.md index
3. Focus on non-obvious learnings that will help future sessions

content.text:
All four changes are verified. Here is the fix summary.

---

**FIX COMPLETE -- Floating Checkmark Icon**

**Mode:** C (Maintenance / Fix Sprint)
**Project:** Pinzo

**Root Cause:** The `.zcc-result` flex container used `align-items: center`, which vertically centered the checkmark icon against the entire height of the result card content. When the content was tall (timeline + scheduling + badges), the icon floated to the midpoint of the card instead of staying next to the success message at the top.

**Changes Made (4 CSS edits, 2 files):**

**File 1:** `/Users/yashbaldha/Desktop/Boldteq App/Pinzo/app/routes/app.widget.tsx` (Admin Preview)
- Line 393: Added `margin-top:2px` to `.zcc-result-icon` -- aligns icon with text baseline
- Line 500: Changed `align-items:center` to `align-items:flex-start` on `.zcc-result` -- pins icon to top

**File 2:** `/Users/yashbaldha/Desktop/Boldteq App/Pinzo/extensions/zip-code-widget/blocks/zip-code-checker.liquid` (Storefront Widget)
- Line 525: Added `margin-top:2px !important` to `.zcc-result-icon` -- aligns icon with text baseline
- Line 630: Changed `align-items:center !important` to `align-items:flex-start !important` on `.zcc-result` -- pins icon to top

**Verification:**
- `npx tsc --noEmit` -- zero errors
- `npm run build` -- passes cleanly
- No other CSS rules were affected (all other `align-items:center` instances verified intact)

**Result:** The checkmark icon now stays pinned at the top-left of the result card, inline with the success message text, regardless of how many content sections are visible below. No more floating icon between timeline and scheduling sections.

# Pinzo Shopify App Improvement Report -- Phased Implementation Plan

## Architecture Summary

The Pinzo app is a Shopify ZIP code delivery checker built on React Router 7 with Polaris v13 UI, Prisma ORM (PostgreSQL), and Shopify Theme App Extensions. The storefront widget is a single monolithic Liquid block (`zip-code-checker.liquid`, ~1279 lines of vanilla JS) that fetches configuration from an API endpoint at runtime. The admin is a set of `app.*.tsx` route files using Polaris components. Email is handled via the Resend SDK.

---

## PHASE 1: CRITICAL BUG FIXES (Live Store Broken)

**Priority: Immediate. These bugs break the merchant's live storefront.**

**Estimated effort: 3-5 days**

---

### 1A. Bug #24 + #25: Floating/Popup Layouts Not Working + Colors Not Reflecting

**Root Cause Analysis (confirmed by code review):**

The widget JS at line 201 fetches config from `API_BASE + "/api/widget-config?shop=" + SHOP`. The `api.widget-config.tsx` endpoint at lines 157-165 **server-side strips colors for Free plan shops** (`widgetFullCustom: false`), resetting them to defaults. It also forces `position: "inline"` at save-time for Free plans (line 160 of `app.widget.tsx`).

The issue is NOT that floating/popup doesn't work in the code -- it does (lines 1088-1261 of the liquid file). The issue is plan-gating: Free plan shops have `widgetFullCustom: false`, which forces `position = "inline"` in both:
- `app.widget.tsx` action (line 160): `data.position = "inline"` 
- `api.widget-config.tsx` (line 160): colors reset to defaults

If the merchant IS on a paid plan and colors still don't reflect, the issue is likely stale metafield caching. The `api.widget-config.tsx` returns `Cache-Control: no-store` (line 192), so API responses are fresh. But the metafield written by `syncConfigMetafield()` is baked into Shopify's CDN. Since the liquid block ignores the metafield and always fetches the API (line 201), this should not be an issue unless App Proxy routing is misconfigured.

**Fix:**
1. Verify the merchant's plan tier. If they are on a paid plan and position/colors still fail, the problem is App Proxy URL resolution. Check if `API_BASE` resolves correctly -- the fallback at line 145 uses `/apps/zipcheck` relative proxy path.
2. Add a console.log in the widget to surface what `cfg.position` and `cfg.primaryColor` values the widget receives, so we can distinguish "API returns wrong data" from "rendering is broken."
3. For colors specifically, double-check that `widgetFullCustom` is `true` for the merchant's plan tier in `plans.ts` (confirmed: it is `true` for starter/pro/ultimate).

**Files to modify:**
- `/Users/yashbaldha/Desktop/Boldteq App/Pinzo/extensions/zip-code-widget/blocks/zip-code-checker.liquid` -- Add diagnostic logging; potentially fix any API_BASE resolution edge cases
- `/Users/yashbaldha/Desktop/Boldteq App/Pinzo/app/routes/api.widget-config.tsx` -- Verify color pass-through for paid plans

---

### 1B. Bug #22 + #31: ZIP Code Functionality Not Working on Frontend

**Root Cause Analysis:**

The ZIP check flow is: widget JS calls `API_BASE + "/api/zip-check?shop=...&zip=..."` (line 735). The `api.zip-check.tsx` normalizes the ZIP (line 108), queries the DB (line 111), and returns allowed/blocked/not-found.

If ZIP checking "doesn't work," the likely causes are:

I now have a comprehensive understanding of the entire codebase. Here is the complete phased implementation plan.

---

# Pinzo Shopify App Improvement Report -- Phased Implementation Plan

## Architecture Summary

The Pinzo app is a Shopify ZIP code delivery checker built on React Router 7 with Polaris v13 UI, Prisma ORM (PostgreSQL), and Shopify Theme App Extensions. The storefront widget is a single monolithic Liquid block (`zip-code-checker.liquid`, ~1279 lines of vanilla JS) that fetches configuration from an API endpoint at runtime. The admin is a set of `app.*.tsx` route files using Polaris components. Email is handled via the Resend SDK.

---

## PHASE 1: CRITICAL BUG FIXES (Live Store Broken)

**Priority: Immediate. These bugs break the merchant's live storefront.**

**Estimated effort: 3-5 days**

---

### 1A. Bug #24 + #25: Floating/Popup Layouts Not Working + Colors Not Reflecting

**Root Cause Analysis (confirmed by code review):**

The widget JS at line 201 fetches config from `API_BASE + "/api/widget-config?shop=" + SHOP`. The `api.widget-config.tsx` endpoint at lines 157-165 **server-side strips colors for Free plan shops** (`widgetFullCustom: false`), resetting them to defaults. It also forces `position: "inline"` at save-time for Free plans (line 160 of `app.widget.tsx`).

The issue is NOT that floating/popup doesn't work in the code -- it does (lines 1088-1261 of the liquid file). The issue is plan-gating: Free plan shops have `widgetFullCustom: false`, which forces `position = "inline"` in both:
- `app.widget.tsx` action (line 160): `data.position = "inline"` 
- `api.widget-config.tsx` (line 160): colors reset to defaults

If the merchant IS on a paid plan and colors still don't reflect, the issue is likely stale metafield caching. The `api.widget-config.tsx` returns `Cache-Control: no-store` (line 192), so API responses are fresh. But the metafield written by `syncConfigMetafield()` is baked into Shopify's CDN. Since the liquid block ignores the metafield and always fetches the API (line 201), this should not be an issue unless App Proxy routing is misconfigured.

**Fix:**
1. Verify the merchant's plan tier. If they are on a paid plan and position/colors still fail, the problem is App Proxy URL resolution. Check if `API_BASE` resolves correctly -- the fallback at line 145 uses `/apps/zipcheck` relative proxy path.
2. Add a console.log in the widget to surface what `cfg.position` and `cfg.primaryColor` values the widget receives, so we can distinguish "API returns wrong data" from "rendering is broken."
3. For colors specifically, double-check that `widgetFullCustom` is `true` for the merchant's plan tier in `plans.ts` (confirmed: it is `true` for starter/pro/ultimate).

**Files to modify:**
- `/Users/yashbaldha/Desktop/Boldteq App/Pinzo/extensions/zip-code-widget/blocks/zip-code-checker.liquid` -- Add diagnostic logging; potentially fix any API_BASE resolution edge cases
- `/Users/yashbaldha/Desktop/Boldteq App/Pinzo/app/routes/api.widget-config.tsx` -- Verify color pass-through for paid plans

---

### 1B. Bug #22 + #31: ZIP Code Functionality Not Working on Frontend

**Root Cause Analysis:**

The ZIP check flow is: widget JS calls `API_BASE + "/api/zip-check?shop=...&zip=..."` (line 735). The `api.zip-check.tsx` normalizes the ZIP (line 108), queries the DB (line 111), and returns allowed/blocked/not-found.

If ZIP checking "doesn't work," the likely causes are:
1. App Proxy not configured -- `API_BASE` falls back to relative `/apps/zipcheck` which Shopify forwards via App Proxy. If App Proxy is not set up in Partners Dashboard, these requests 404 on the store.
2. App embed not enabled -- the widget polls for `window.__zccAppEnabled` (set by `app-embed.liquid` line 8). If the embed is disabled, the widget never initializes (line 115-120).
3. No ZIP codes in the database -- the API returns `notFound: true` for any ZIP not in the DB (unless `defaultBehavior: "allow"`).

**Fix:**
1. Add better error surfacing in the widget when API calls fail (line 971-982 already catches errors but only shows "Something went wrong"). Add the actual URL attempted to the console error.
2. On the admin Dashboard (`app._index.tsx`), add a diagnostic check that tests the App Proxy URL is reachable.
3. Ensure the FAQ/Help page explains the App Proxy setup requirement.

**Files to modify:**
- `/Users/yashbaldha/Desktop/Boldteq App/Pinzo/extensions/zip-code-widget/blocks/zip-code-checker.liquid` -- Better error logging on API failure
- `/Users/yashbaldha/Desktop/Boldteq App/Pinzo/app/routes/app._index.tsx` -- Add App Proxy health check

---

### 1C. Bug #17 + #28: Email "Notify by ZIP" Not Sending -- Error Says "Postmark" but App Uses Resend

**Root Cause Analysis (confirmed):**

The codebase does NOT mention Postmark anywhere (verified by grep). The actual error message at line 142 of `app.settings.tsx` is: `"Failed to send test email. Check your Resend API key and sender email."` -- so the error text correctly says "Resend." The user's report of "Postmark" is either a misquote or a stale cached error from a previous version.

The real issue is that `sendZipAvailableNotification()` in `email.server.ts` (line 178) can fail if:
1. `RESEND_API_KEY` env var is not set (line 33: returns `null`, function returns `false`)
2. The sender domain is not verified in Resend (emails silently fail)
3. The "Notify by ZIP" action at line 148 of `app.waitlist.tsx` does send emails via `sendZipAvailableNotification()` and reports `emailsSent` count at line 182 -- but the UI may not clearly distinguish "0 emails sent" from "emails attempted but failed."

**Fix:**
1. In `app.waitlist.tsx`, when `emailsSent === 0` but `count > 0`, show a warning banner explaining possible causes (RESEND_API_KEY not set, domain not verified).
2. Add a health check in the settings page that tests whether `getClient()` returns a valid client.
3. Update the error message to be more diagnostic -- include whether the API key is set (without revealing the key itself).

**Files to modify:**
- `/Users/yashbaldha/Desktop/Boldteq App/Pinzo/app/routes/app.waitlist.tsx` -- Add warning when emailsSent is 0
- `/Users/yashbaldha/Desktop/Boldteq App/Pinzo/app/routes/app.settings.tsx` -- Better email diagnostic feedback
- `/Users/yashbaldha/Desktop/Boldteq App/Pinzo/app/email.server.ts` -- Add `isConfigured()` export function

---

### 1D. Bug #59: Waitlist Form Not Appearing When Invalid ZIP Entered

**Root Cause Analysis (confirmed):**

The waitlist form IS rendered when `cfg.showWaitlistOnFailure` is true (line 887-898 of the liquid file). The form includes name, email, and ZIP fields with the ZIP pre-populated (line 894: `value="' + escAttr(zip) + '"`).

The issue is that `showWaitlistOnFailure` must be enabled in Widget Settings by the merchant. If the merchant has not toggled this on, the form does not appear. The default is `false` (line 230 of the liquid, line 115 of `WidgetConfig` schema).

However, there is a real bug: the waitlist form only appears for `blocked` and `notFound` ZIP results. Looking at the API response at line 165-169, `showWaitlist` is only set to `true` when the widgetConfig has `showWaitlistOnFailure: true`. This is correct.

The actual bug may be timing: the waitlist section (`zcc-wl`) is rendered inside `res.innerHTML` (line 898), but if the error result card has `padding` and the waitlist form has `margin-top`, there could be visibility/scroll issues, especially in floating/popup mode where the panel has constrained height.

**Fix:**
1. When the merchant has `showWaitlistOnFailure` disabled and a customer enters an invalid ZIP, show a subtle prompt to the merchant in the admin ("Tip: Enable waitlist on your Widget Settings page to capture these customers").
2. If `showWaitlistOnFailure` IS enabled but the form is not visible, the issue is likely that floating/popup mode constrains the panel height. Add `overflow-y: auto` to the panel/modal content area.
3. Verify the form renders correctly in all three positions (inline, floating, popup).

**Files to modify:**
- `/Users/yashbaldha/Desktop/Boldteq App/Pinzo/extensions/zip-code-widget/blocks/zip-code-checker.liquid` -- Add scroll overflow to floating panel and popup modal content
- `/Users/yashbaldha/Desktop/Boldteq App/Pinzo/app/routes/app.widget.tsx` -- Make `showWaitlistOnFailure` more prominent in the UI

---

### 1E. Bug #71: Edit Modal Flickering/Jumping When Editing ZIP Code

**Root Cause Analysis:**

The edit modal in `app.zip-codes.tsx` (line 1677-1757) is a standard Polaris `Modal` with `TextField` inputs. Modal flickering typically occurs when React re-renders the modal component due to state changes that propagate up and cause the parent to re-render.

The likely cause: The `editZip` state at line 596 is updated via `setEditZip` (line 1702) which triggers a re-render. If the `actionError` state (line 1696) or `isEditLoading` (line 1685) changes at the same time, the modal may briefly unmount and remount.

Another possibility: The `onChange={setEditZip}` callback at line 1702 causes the parent IndexTable to re-filter/re-paginate if `editZip` is accidentally used in the filter logic.

**Fix:**
1. Isolate the edit modal state into a dedicated component or use `useMemo` to prevent unnecessary parent re-renders.
2. Ensure the `actionError` banner inside the modal doesn't cause layout shift by reserving space for it or using a fixed-height container.
3. Add `key={editId}` to the Modal to prevent React from reusing DOM between different edit operations.

**Files to modify:**
- `/Users/yashbaldha/Desktop/Boldteq App/Pinzo/app/routes/app.zip-codes.tsx` -- Stabilize edit modal rendering

---

### 1F. Bug #3 + #36 + #60: Add to Cart Button Not Locked for Inline Mode

**Root Cause Analysis (confirmed):**

This is a deliberate code decision, NOT a bug. At line 252 of the liquid file: `if (!cfg.lockButtonsUntilZipCheck || cfg.position === 'inline') { _zccUnlock(); }` -- inline mode explicitly unlocks buttons because "inline widget is directly visible -- customer doesn't need to hunt for it" (code comment at line 251).

The `lockAtcButtonsForZipCheck()` function at line 278 is only called for floating/popup: `if (cfg.lockButtonsUntilZipCheck && (cfg.position === "floating" || cfg.position === "popup"))`.

The separate `blockCartOnInvalid` feature (line 267-327) DOES work for inline mode -- it blocks buttons initially and only unblocks on successful ZIP check. But it requires the Pro plan (`cartBlocking: true` only for pro/ultimate in `plans.ts`).

The gap is: for inline mode, there is no free/starter-tier way to lock ATC buttons. The `lockButtonsUntilZipCheck` setting intentionally skips inline because the widget is visible and the user can see the checker.

Additionally, there is a real gap at line 937-968: when `blockCartOnInvalid` is true and the user enters an INVALID zip, the code correctly re-blocks buttons (line 959-964). But when the user edits the ZIP input (lines 995-1037), it only re-blocks if the LAST check was successful. If the last check was invalid, the buttons stay blocked (correct behavior).

**Fix:**
1. Extend `lockButtonsUntilZipCheck` to optionally work in inline mode. Add a new config option or change the behavior: if merchant explicitly enables `lockButtonsUntilZipCheck`, honor it regardless of position. Remove the `cfg.position === 'inline'` exception.
2. The CSS-based pre-lock (`_zccLock`/`_zccUnlock`) already works for all positions -- only the JS-based `lockAtcButtonsForZipCheck()` event listener setup needs to be called for inline too.
3. Update the pre-lock release condition at line 252 to only skip for inline when `lockButtonsUntilZipCheck` is explicitly false.

**Files to modify:**
- `/Users/yashbaldha/Desktop/Boldteq App/Pinzo/extensions/zip-code-widget/blocks/zip-code-checker.liquid` -- Remove inline exception for lockButtonsUntilZipCheck, add event listener for inline mode
- `/Users/yashbaldha/Desktop/Boldteq App/Pinzo/app/routes/app.widget.tsx` -- Update tooltip/help text for the setting to explain it now works for all positions

---

### 1G. Bug #2: Widget Visible in Theme Editor When App Disabled

**Root Cause Analysis:**

The `zip-code-checker.liquid` file at lines 7-93 handles `request.design_mode`. It shows two states: "inactive" (app embed disabled) and "active" (app embed enabled). The switch is done by checking `window.__zccAppEnabled` (set by `app-embed.liquid`).

The polling at lines 82-92 uses `setTimeout(check, 500)`, `setTimeout(check, 1500)`, `setTimeout(check, 3000)`. If the app embed loads after 3 seconds, the widget stays in "inactive" state. But if the app embed is DISABLED (toggled off in Theme Editor), `window.__zccAppEnabled` is never set, and the widget correctly shows "inactive."

The reported issue is that the widget is "still visible" even when the app is disabled. This likely means the inactive placeholder itself is visible, which is by design -- it tells the merchant to enable the embed. But if the merchant wants to FULLY hide the widget, they need to remove the block entirely.

**Fix:**
1. Make the inactive placeholder styling less prominent -- use a smaller, more minimal design.
2. OR add a check: if the block has been in the theme for more than 5 seconds and the embed is still not detected, collapse the placeholder to a single line.

**Files to modify:**
- `/Users/yashbaldha/Desktop/Boldteq App/Pinzo/extensions/zip-code-widget/blocks/zip-code-checker.liquid` -- Refine design_mode placeholder behavior

---

## PHASE 2: STOREFRONT WIDGET UI FIXES

**Priority: High. Visual quality issues that affect customer trust.**

**Estimated effort: 2-3 days**

---

### 2A. Bug #10 + #23: Search Icon Too Small vs Button Text

**Location:** Line 512 of liquid file: `.zcc-btn-icon svg{width:15px !important;height:15px !important}` and `.zcc-btn` font-size is `14px` (line 623).

**Fix:** Increase icon to 16px or 17px to match the text visual weight. In the CSS at line 512, change `width:15px` and `height:15px` to `width:17px` and `height:17px`.

**File:** `/Users/yashbaldha/Desktop/Boldteq App/Pinzo/extensions/zip-code-widget/blocks/zip-code-checker.liquid`

---

### 2B. Bug #11: "Check Delivery Availability" Heading Appearing Twice in Floating/Popup

**Root Cause (confirmed):** 

For floating mode, the panel header at line 1134 shows `Delivery Check` (not the heading). The `buildWidgetInner` call at line 1141 passes `false` for `showHeading`, so the inline heading is suppressed. Same for popup at line 1236.

So the heading should NOT appear twice. However, the popup modal header at line 1229-1230 uses `cfg.heading` which IS "Check Delivery Availability." If the merchant's heading is long, the modal header AND any remnant could create a "double heading" perception.

**Fix:** Verify this is actually happening. If it is, the popup trigger button at line 1218-1219 uses `cfg.buttonText || cfg.heading` -- if `buttonText` is empty, it falls back to the heading, creating a visual "double" (trigger button says heading text, modal header says heading text). Fix: always use `cfg.buttonText` for the trigger, fall back to "Check" not the heading.

**File:** `/Users/yashbaldha/Desktop/Boldteq App/Pinzo/extensions/zip-code-widget/blocks/zip-code-checker.liquid` -- Line 1219

---

### 2C. Bug #37: Popup Widget Missing Bottom Border-Radius

**Location:** Line 1189: the modal has `border-radius:16px`. But the content inside (`buildWidgetInner`) is rendered in a div at line 1235 with `padding:16px 24px 24px`. The border-radius should be inherited. The issue may be `overflow:hidden` at line 1188 not clipping the content properly.

**Fix:** Add `border-radius: 0 0 16px 16px` to the inner content wrapper or ensure `overflow:hidden` on the modal container clips correctly.

### 1C. Email notifications not sending (#17, #28)
- **Root cause**: App uses Resend (NOT Postmark). Sajid's error message references Postmark incorrectly — actual error says "Check your Resend API key." Possible: RESEND_API_KEY env var not set on Railway, or sender domain not verified.

Fix 5 critical storefront bugs in the Pinzo Shopify app at `/Users/yashbaldha/Desktop/Boldteq App/Pinzo`. These all touch the storefront widget file.

Read CLAUDE.md first, then read the plan at `/Users/yashbaldha/.claude/plans/sunny-plotting-treasure.md` for full context.

## Bug 1A: Floating/Popup layouts always showing Inline + Colors not reflecting (#24, #25)

Read `app/routes/api.widget-config.tsx` fully. The issue is plan-gating:
- For Free plan (`widgetFullCustom: false`), position is forced to "inline" and colors reset to defaults
- For paid plans, these should pass through correctly

**Fix needed:**
1. In `api.widget-config.tsx`, verify that `widgetFullCustom` correctly allows position and colors for Starter+ plans
2. In `zip-code-checker.liquid`, add a `console.warn` when the received config position doesn't match what was expected (for debugging). Log: `[Pinzo] Config loaded: position=${cfg.position}, plan allows full custom=${cfg.widgetFullCustom !== undefined}`
3. Make sure the widget config API is returning the saved position and colors for paid plans — the plan-gating code should ONLY strip for Free plan

## Bug 1B: ZIP Code check not working on frontend (#22, #31)

Read the widget's API call logic in `zip-code-checker.liquid`. The widget uses `API_BASE` which resolves to the App Proxy URL (`/apps/zipcheck`).

**Fix needed:**
1. In `zip-code-checker.liquid`, improve error handling when the API call fails. Currently shows generic "Something went wrong. Please try again." — add console.error with the actual URL and response status
2. Add a fallback: if App Proxy returns 404, try direct API URL as fallback

## Bug 1D: Waitlist form not appearing on invalid ZIP (#59)

The waitlist form only shows when `showWaitlistOnFailure` is enabled in Widget Settings AND the API returns `showWaitlist: true`.

**Fix needed:**
1. In `zip-code-checker.liquid`, add `overflow-y: auto; max-height: 70vh` to the floating panel content area and popup modal content area so the waitlist form is scrollable when the panel is too short
2. In `app/routes/app.widget.tsx`, make the `showWaitlistOnFailure` toggle more visually prominent (move it higher in the settings, or add a callout)

## Bug 1F: Add to Cart buttons not locked in Inline mode (#3, #36, #60)

Read `zip-code-checker.liquid` around line 252. Currently: `if (!cfg.lockButtonsUntilZipCheck || cfg.position === 'inline') { _zccUnlock(); }` — this INTENTIONALLY skips locking for inline.

**Fix needed:**
1. Remove the `cfg.position === 'inline'` exception. If `lockButtonsUntilZipCheck` is true, honor it for ALL positions including inline.
2. Change line 278's condition from `if (cfg.lockButtonsUntilZipCheck && (cfg.position === "floating" || cfg.position === "popup"))` to just `if (cfg.lockButtonsUntilZipCheck)` — apply the lock event listener for all positions
3. Update the `lockAtcButtonsForZipCheck` function to work for inline too — the CSS injection already handles all positions, only the JS event listener setup needs the condition change
4. In `app/routes/app.widget.tsx`, update the helpText for the `lockButtonsUntilZipCheck` toggle to say "Disable Add to Cart and Buy Now buttons until a valid ZIP code is checked. Works for all widget positions."

## Bug 1G: Widget visible in editor when app disabled (#2)

Read `zip-code-checker.liquid` lines 7-93. The "inactive" placeholder is too prominent.

**Fix needed:**
1. Make the inactive placeholder more minimal — a single line of text with a small icon instead of a large block. Something like: `[Pinzo icon] Enable App Embed to activate the ZIP Code Checker`
2. Use subtle styling: light gray background, small font, no large padding

## RULES
- Read CLAUDE.md before coding
- Read each file fully before editing
- Keep all existing class names
- Run `npx tsc --noEmit` and `npm run build` after all changes
- Both admin preview in `app.widget.tsx` and storefront in `zip-code-checker.liquid` must stay in sync where applicable

- `app/email.server.ts` — email service
- `app/routes/app.waitlist.tsx` — "Notify by ZIP" feature
- `app/routes/app.settings.tsx` — test email and notification config

**Issues to fix:**
1. Add an `isEmailConfigured()` export to `email.server.ts` that checks if `RESEND_API_KEY` is set and the Resend client is initialized. This helps the admin UI show clear diagnostics.
2. In `app/routes/app.settings.tsx`, when the test email fails, the error message should clearly say whether the API key is missing vs the send failed. Check if the current error message references "Postmark" anywhere — if so, fix it to say "Resend".
3. In `app/routes/app.waitlist.tsx`, when the "Notify by ZIP" action sends emails and `emailsSent === 0` but there were waiting customers, show a warning toast that says "No emails were sent. Check your email settings in Settings → Email Notifications."

Read `app/routes/app.zip-codes.tsx` — the edit ZIP code modal.

**Issues to fix:**
1. Find the edit Modal component and add `key={editingZipId || 'new'}` to prevent React from reusing DOM between different edit operations
2. Check if the `actionError` Banner inside the modal causes layout shifts — if so, reserve space for it or use conditional rendering that doesn't shift layout
3. Look for any state updates that trigger parent re-renders during editing. If `editZip` state or related values are used in the IndexTable filter/sort logic, isolate them.
4. Make sure the modal form state is stable — inputs shouldn't jump when typing

## RULES  
- Read CLAUDE.md before coding
- Run `npx tsc --noEmit` after all changes
- Run `npm run build` to verify
- Use Polaris components only for admin UI

<result>All fixes are in place. Here is the complete bug report:

---

**Bug 1C — Email notifications not sending**

**Severity:** P1 — Merchants who set up email but have no API key silently get zero notifications. No diagnostic feedback.

**Root Causes (4 items fixed):**

1. `email.server.ts` had no exported `isEmailConfigured()` function, so the settings UI had no way to check whether the Resend client could ever succeed before attempting a send.

2. `app.settings.tsx` sent the same generic failure message regardless of whether `RESEND_API_KEY` was missing entirely or was set but produced a send error. The word "Postmark" was not present (already used Resend correctly), but the message was still too vague to be actionable.

3. `app.waitlist.tsx` — when `emailsSent === 0` and `count > 0` (customers were waiting), the result modal already showed a banner warning, but no toast fired. If a merchant dismissed the modal quickly they would see no feedback at all that emails failed to send.

4. `sendZipAvailableNotification` returned `false` on null client but logged nothing. The null path now logs a warning with the specific reason.

**Fixes applied:**
- `/Users/yashbaldha/Desktop/Boldteq App/Pinzo/app/email.server.ts` — Added `export function isEmailConfigured()` checking `RESEND_API_KEY`. Added explicit `console.warn` to `sendZipAvailableNotification`'s null-client path.
- `/Users/yashbaldha/Desktop/Boldteq App/Pinzo/app/routes/app.settings.tsx` — Imported `isEmailConfigured`. Action now calls it before `sendTestEmail` and returns a distinct error message: "RESEND_API_KEY environment variable is missing" vs "verify your RESEND_API_KEY is valid and your sender domain is verified in the Resend dashboard."
- `/Users/yashbaldha/Desktop/Boldteq App/Pinzo/app/routes/app.waitlist.tsx` — The notify result `useEffect` now fires a `shopify.toast.show(..., { isError: true })` when `count > 0 && emailsSent === 0`, directing the merchant to Settings → Email Notifications.

---

**Bug 1E — Edit modal flickering**

**Severity:** P2 — Modal DOM reuse between different ZIP records causes stale field values, visual jumps when typing, and error banners from one operation bleeding into another.

**Root Causes (3 items fixed):**

1. The edit `Modal` had no `key` prop. When the merchant clicked Edit on record A, then Edit on record B, React reused the existing modal DOM and only updated state via `setState` calls. During the commit phase this caused fields to flash between old and new values.

2. `actionError` was derived from shared `fetcher.data` with no intent scoping. An error from the Add modal's submit would show inside the open Edit modal (and vice versa), because both modals read the same `actionError` variable.

3. The Banner inside the edit modal appeared/disappeared unconditionally, causing form fields below it to shift down when an error appeared (layout jump).

**Fixes applied:**
- `/Users/yashbaldha/Desktop/Boldteq App/Pinzo/app/routes/app.zip-codes.tsx`:
  - Added `key={editId || "new"}` to the edit Modal. React now treats each ZIP record's edit as a distinct component instance and fully remounts the modal DOM when `editId` changes, eliminating the flicker.
  - Added `lastSubmittedIntent` derived from `fetcher.formData?.get("intent")`. Introduced `addModalError` (only active when intent is `"add"`) and `editModalError` (only active when intent is `"update"`). Each modal now reads only its own scoped error — errors cannot cross modals.
  - Wrapped the Banner in `<div style={{ minHeight: editModalError ? undefined : 0 }}>` so the slot occupies zero height when empty and does not cause a layout jump when the error appears.

**Regression Risk:** The `key` prop on the Modal causes a full remount on every `editId` change. This is intentional and correct. The only side effect is that Polaris animation for the modal open/close will replay from scratch — which is the desired behaviour (fresh state). No data fetching or side effects are attached to modal mount, so this is safe.

**Prevention:** Scoped error variables (`addModalError`, `editModalError`) should be the standard pattern for any page with multiple modals sharing a single fetcher. `key` prop on modals is mandatory when the same modal component is reused for multiple records.

**Post-Fix Checklist:**
- `npx tsc --noEmit` — zero errors
- `npm run build` — clean build, 2.52s client + 536ms SSR
- Test email error message now reads "RESEND_API_KEY environment variable is missing" when key absent
- Edit modal remounts when switching between ZIP records (no stale fields)
- Zero email toast fires when notify-zip action sends 0 emails to waiting customers</result>

Fix storefront widget UI issues in the Pinzo app at `/Users/yashbaldha/Desktop/Boldteq App/Pinzo`. Read CLAUDE.md first.

All changes are in `extensions/zip-code-widget/blocks/zip-code-checker.liquid`. Read the FULL file before editing.

## Fixes needed:

### 1. Search icon too small (#10, #23)
The button icon SVG is 15x15px but button text is 14px font. The icon looks disproportionately small.
- Find `.zcc-btn-icon svg` CSS — change width/height from 15px to 17px
- Also find the button SVG in the JS buildWidgetInner function and verify it uses `stroke-width="2.5"` for visual weight

### 2. Heading appearing twice in popup/floating (#11)
The popup trigger button at the bottom-right uses `cfg.heading` as fallback text when `cfg.buttonText` is empty. This means the trigger shows "Check Delivery Availability" AND the modal header also shows "Check Delivery Availability" — creating a visual "double heading".
- Fix: When building the trigger button text, fall back to `cfg.buttonText || "Check"` instead of `cfg.buttonText || cfg.heading`
- Also check the floating trigger button for the same issue

### 3. Popup missing bottom border-radius (#37)
The popup modal has `border-radius: 16px` on the container but content inside may overflow and clip the bottom corners.
- Add `overflow: hidden` to the modal container if not already present
- Ensure the inner content wrapper also has `border-radius: 0 0 16px 16px` on the bottom

### 4. Close (X) button too faint (#52)
Both floating panel and popup modal close buttons have `opacity: 0.5`.
- Change to `opacity: 0.7` for default state
- Keep hover state at `opacity: 1`

### 5. Alignment/spacing inconsistencies (#43, #44, #45, #51)
- Error/denied result card: Ensure icon and text are vertically centered (align-items: center on the flex row)
- Success result card: Icon stays at top (align-items: flex-start) — this is correct since success has more content below
- Waitlist form: Normalize padding to match result cards
- Waitlist success message: Icon and text alignment should match error state
- Spacing between the ZIP input form and the result section should be consistent (12px gap)

### 6. Spacing around widget box (#61)
- Add `margin: 12px 0` to the main widget container in inline mode so it has breathing room from surrounding product page elements
- Don't add margin in floating/popup modes (they're overlays)

## RULES
- Keep ALL existing CSS class names
- Keep all conditional rendering logic
- Run `npx tsc --noEmit` and `npm run build` after changes
- Only modify `zip-code-checker.liquid` — do NOT touch admin preview files

- `Page` component (line 1391) with title, subtitle, backAction, primaryAction, secondaryActions
- `Layout` wrapper (line 1412) inside `Box` with large bottom padding
- **Error banner** (lines 1414-1420) for save errors

- `InlineGrid` with responsive columns (line 1424): `xs: 1` (mobile = stacked), `md: 2` (desktop = side-by-side)
- Left column (BlockStack) contains all settings cards in vertical stack
- Right column (sticky div at line 1929) contains Live Preview card with `position: sticky; top: 16px`

**Save/Discard/Reset Buttons:**
- **Save button**: Page's `primaryAction` (lines 1395-1399) — appears only if `isDirty === true`
- **Discard button**: In `secondaryActions` (lines 1400-1404) — appears only if `isDirty === true`
- **Reset to Defaults button**: Always in `secondaryActions` (lines 1405-1408) — opens confirmation modal
- **Modal confirmation** (lines 2044-2067): Reset modal with destructive primary action

---

### **3. STATE VARIABLES (useState Hooks)**

All state initialized at lines 1149-1191:

**Form State (from config):**
- Line 1149: `position` (string)
- Lines 1150-1154: Colors (5 states): `primaryColor`, `successColor`, `errorColor`, `backgroundColor`, `textColor`
- Lines 1155-1160: Text content (6 states): `heading`, `placeholder`, `buttonText`, `successMessage`, `errorMessage`, `notFoundMessage`
- Lines 1161-1172: Display toggles (12 states): `showEta`, `showZone`, `showWaitlistOnFailure`, `showCod`, `showReturnPolicy`, `showCutoffTime`, `showDeliveryDays`, `showDeliveryDate`, `showCountdown`, `showDeliveryFee`
- Lines 1173-1174: Purchase protection (2 states): `blockCartOnInvalid`, `blockCheckoutInCart`
- Lines 1175-1180: Misc (4 states): `showSocialProof`, `lockButtonsUntilZipCheck`, `waitlistTitle`, `waitlistButtonText`, `borderRadius`, `customCss`

| Section | Lines | Contains | State Variables |

| **Colors** | 1476-1672 | 5 color pickers + border radius | `primaryColor`, `successColor`, `errorColor`, `backgroundColor`, `textColor`, `borderRadius` |
| **Text Content** | 1675-1722 | 6 text fields | `heading`, `placeholder`, `buttonText`, `successMessage`, `errorMessage`, `notFoundMessage` |
| **Display Options** | 1725-1886 | Nested subsections: |  |
| — ZIP Code Waitlist | 1735-1747 | 1 checkbox + banner | `showWaitlistOnFailure` |
| — ETA/Delivery Toggles | 1748-1806 | 8 checkboxes | `showEta`, `showZone`, `showCutoffTime`, `showDeliveryDays`, `showDeliveryDate`, `showCountdown`, `showDeliveryFee`, `showCod`, `showReturnPolicy` |
| — Purchase Protection | 1821-1860 | 3 checkboxes (divider at 1821) | `blockCartOnInvalid`, `blockCheckoutInCart`, `lockButtonsUntilZipCheck` |
| — Waitlist Engagement | 1862-1884 | 3 controls | `showSocialProof`, `waitlistTitle`, `waitlistButtonText` |
| **Custom CSS** | 1889-1925 | 1 textarea (4 rows) + plan badge | `customCss` |

### **5. LIVE PREVIEW PANEL**

**Location:** Right column, sticky div (line 1929-2038)

**Structure:**
- Header with position badge (1932-1939)
- **Preview state toggle buttons** (1942-1989): Custom pill-style tabs showing 4 states:
  - "Default" (idle) — gray
  - "Success" — green (#22c55e)
  - "Blocked" (error) — red (#ef4444)
  - "Not Found" (notfound) — amber (#f59e0b)
- Plan enforcement warning (lines 1992-1999) — shown when not on Starter+
- **Device mockup frame** (lines 2002-2035):
  - Browser chrome header with 3 traffic light dots (lines 2009-2021)
  - Dot-grid background background (lines 2023-2035)
  - WidgetPreview component renders the actual widget inside the frame

**Preview Component Logic** (WidgetPreview, lines 797-1069):
- Memoized to avoid re-renders
- Accepts: `cfg`, `previewState`, `widgetFullCustom`, `showEtaCodReturn`
- Renders different UI based on `previewState`:
  - Idle: Empty search bar
  - Success: Search bar + result card + timeline/meta info
  - Error/NotFound: Error message + optional waitlist form
- Position-aware rendering (lines 1048-1068):
  - Floating: FloatingPreview component (button + panel toggle)
  - Popup: PopupPreview component (button + modal overlay)
  - Inline: Direct widget rendering

---

### **6. BUTTON LOCATIONS**

| Button | Type | Location | Line(s) | Conditions |
|--------|------|----------|---------|-----------|
| **Save Changes** | Primary Action | Page header | 1395-1399 | Only shows if `isDirty === true` |
| **Discard** | Secondary Action | Page header | 1400-1404 | Only shows if `isDirty === true` |
| **Reset to Defaults** | Secondary Action | Page header | 1405-1408 | Always visible |
| **Reset Confirm (modal)** | Destructive Primary | Modal | 2048-2051 | In confirmation modal (lines 2044-2067) |
| **Cancel (modal)** | Secondary | Modal | 2053-2057 | In confirmation modal |

---

### **7. KEY IMPLEMENTATION DETAILS FOR TAB RESTRUCTURING**

**Change tracking:** 
- All field changes trigger `mark()` callback (line 1218) which sets `isDirty = true`
- Save/discard handlers use callback refs to update all 30+ state variables
- `handleSave` (lines 1250-1294) collects all state into FormData and submits
- `handleDiscard` (lines 1355-1388) resets all state from original config

**Preview coupling:**
- `previewCfg` memoized object (lines 1337-1353) bundles all config state
- Passed to WidgetPreview which shows real-time preview of changes
- Plan limits applied in WidgetPreview via `effectiveCfg` (lines 812-834)

**Plan enforcement:**
- `limits` object computed from subscription tier (line 1146)
- Used to disable/gate: position tiles, color pickers, display toggles, custom CSS
- Plan info badges shown on restricted cards (Starter+, Pro+, Ultimate)

---

This structure is well-suited for tab reorganization. The 6 main settings groups (Layout, Colors, Text, Display Options, Custom CSS) + Live Preview can cleanly map to tabs. The Display Options section has clear subsections that could become nested tabs or collapsible sections within the tab.
